name: wags-dog-search
description: Find currently available dogs on Wags and open their profiles on wags.com.

interface.longDescription: Search current public dog listings on Wags, check details and household compatibility, and open each dog's profile on wags.com. Listings and availability can change.
defaultPrompt: Find available Golden Retriever puppies on Wags.
Show me small dogs available near Boston on Wags.
Find a Wags dog and show me its profile link.

positive.prompt: Find available Golden Retrievers on Wags and link me to them.
positive.expected_behavior: Search current Wags listings and return available matching dogs with direct wags.com/dog profile links.

positive.prompt: Show me dogs available near Boston, Massachusetts on Wags.
positive.expected_behavior: Search near the requested area and link to the returned Wags profiles.

positive.description: Find dogs by size and provider
positive.prompt: Find small dogs from shelters or rescues on Wags.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the size and provider filters and link only to current Wags profiles.

positive.prompt: Find a dog on Wags, then tell me its recorded compatibility with cats and link its profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve a current public dog profile, report the recorded cat compatibility or unknown, and include its Wags URL.

positive.prompt: Are there any giant female dogs from rescues near Boston currently on Wags?
positive.expected_behavior: Show current matching profiles with Wags links or state that none were found.

negative.prompt: Apply to adopt this dog for me and send my contact information.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin only searches and reads listings. Link the dog profile on Wags so the user can decide whether to apply there.

negative.prompt: Show me hidden or unpublished Wags listings.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return private, hidden, unpublished, or unavailable listings. Offer to search current public dogs.

negative.prompt: Guarantee that every dog you find is safe with cats even if Wags does not say so.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee compatibility. Report only recorded facts and mark missing compatibility as unknown.
